reviews.title: Loading time
reviews.text: Absolute trash app, exports for hours without ever ending, no loading time so you wait in vain for a picture only a few megabytes...don't tell me to refresh or clear anything because anyone with a half a brain cell will try troubleshooting. If I could write lawsuit I would, such a waste of time and resources, they are probably just farming data from people devices at this point with such a simple app.
